summary: Full end-to-end frontend test of V2 Memory Archive cinematic 17-step flow on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile smoke (390x844). All 17 steps navigated successfully from Boot -> Intro -> CH01 opener -> Problem -> Confession -> CH02 opener -> Memories -> transition-missing (auto) -> Lost -> CH03 opener -> Earn (moving NO button confirmed dodging) -> Score -> transition-lost (auto) -> CH04 opener (verified dark background rgb(110,89,65)) -> Apology -> Final Request (second moving NO button dodges) -> Unlock (RECOVERED). Chapter marker HUD renders correctly per chapter (verified CH 01, CH 02 after re-check, CH 03, CH 04) and is absent on boot/intro. Share button POST /api/archive returns id and text updates to 'link copied'. GET /api/archive/{id} returns persisted config. No horizontal overflow on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Experience.jsx: chapter marker uses AnimatePresence keyed on ch.n with a 0.6s delay + 0.8s duration; during the entering half of a new chapter both the outgoing and incoming markers coexist briefly. Not a bug (deliberate fade), but automated tests that read text_content immediately after step change may see the old chapter for up to ~1.4s. Consider setting mode='wait' on the marker AnimatePresence to make it deterministic.
MovingNoButton: uses Math.random() for dodge position — works but occasionally the delta is small (test observed ~22px). Fine for humans, but consider minimum displacement to guarantee visible dodge.

config.js unlock.audioSrc is empty string, so the audio player is hidden and a fallback line 'add your clip in config' appears — acceptable for private release but flag to owner if audio was intended.
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway archive doc via POST /api/archive (id d0a8425d-5832-4208-beca-20967e6bacb5) to verify persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 17-step flow with 4 ChapterOpener steps and marker HUD all verified working. Backend /api/archive POST+GET verified. Mobile 390x844 renders boot & CH01 opener with no horizontal overflow. If retesting marker synchronization, wait ~1600ms after entering a chapter step before asserting marker text due to AnimatePresence exit overlap.
